newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen Petrochemical 96 net 30 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen Petrochemical 96 net 30 mln yuan.

text.p: Shenzhen Petrochemical (Holdings) Co Ltd registered net profits of 30.48 million yuan for 1996, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said in a notice after the market closed on Tuesday.
Earnings per share were 0.10 yuan and turnover reached 1.75 billion yuan in 1996, the exchange said.
It did not say whether the figures were based on Chinese or international accounting standards or give comparative figures.
In 1995, the company posted net profits of 36.01 million yuan under international standards.
The company proposed no dividend for 1996, the exchange said.
Trading in Petrochemical's A and B shares will be suspended on Wednesday morning and will resume in the afternoon, it said.
